research_question: Run a minimal live Stage-0 canary: use deterministic search_web to find one source about an FTMO/MT5-relevant, falsifiable trading mechanism; capture exactly one discovered URL with capture_url_source using source_id SRC-LIVE-CANARY-001 and source_class web; call search_research_memory, check_duplicate_memory, and check_failed_pattern_similarity; then record exactly one hypothesis_packet_v1-compatible hypothesis citing SRC-LIVE-CANARY-001. Do not claim profitability, WFA, MT5 execution, MQL5 parity, promotion, Sharpe, returns, account access, or live trading.

mt5_instrument_scope.allowed_scope: Any broker-supported FTMO/MT5 symbol with enough data and plausible mechanism; not crypto-only; prediction markets excluded.
mt5_instrument_scope.mt5_verified_requires: terminal-backed mt5_instrument_equivalence before any external/current data becomes MT5-bound

prior_lessons: For live tool mode, capture_url_source must include source_id, url, and source_class; the URL must be one returned by search_web in the same run.
record_hypothesis must cite captured source id SRC-LIVE-CANARY-001 and must include source_claims only as Stage-0 source-backed mechanism claims, not MT5 verification or profitability claims.
